curated-gf-alkatra-gf-biorhyme-expanded: BioRhyme Expanded reads bookish and wide, every word breaking into single letters with open gaps. And Alkatra does bold display best, hairlines present but not razor thin, while the serif body does best on brief text.
curated-gf-allan-fs-roundo: Tight, bold, expressive: Allan hugs its letters together, its y tail matching its arm. Roundo takes the quieter job, with unclogged small counters and an n matched arch to stem, pleasant in modest amounts.
curated-gf-allura-gf-della-respira: Della Respira speaks with an authoritative, editorial voice. Allura's smooth single-width strokes sit against those towering capitals, lovely in brief text and even a cute bakery branding mockup.
curated-gf-allura-zilla-slab: Zilla Slab reads sturdy and technical, fine for general purpose use. Allura does graceful, friendly handwriting best, its strokes one stylus wide, while the slab's broad open curves are happiest on brief lines.
curated-gf-alumni-sans-inline-one-gf-not: Expressive heavy downstrokes and cobweb-fine upstrokes make Alumni Sans Inline One loud and narrow. Noto Serif Balinese settles things with gentle stroke variation and great vertical presence, better suited to brief text.
curated-gf-alumni-sans-inline-one-noto-s: Noto Serif reads literary, with a prominent x-height. Its thinnest strokes stay sturdy and its thickest restrained, which keeps brief text smooth, beside Alumni Sans Inline One, whose hairline joins could headline a dark fantasy game title.
curated-gf-amarante-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: BhuTuka Expanded One slows to a leisurely walk beneath Amarante. Curvy, unclamped letters and joins no thinner than the stems feel literary, though lengthy paragraphs would be asking too much.
curated-gf-amarante-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab stretches out, bookish and dignified. Amarante does the bold, curling heading work with gently swelling curves, while the slab's compass-drawn consistency and breathing counters are best taken in light helpings.
curated-gf-angkor-gf-arsenal: Arsenal reads approachable and close-knit, its x-height nearly matching the caps and its gaps barely registering (gothic cafe branding, say). Angkor looms above, bold and tight-mouthed, a pairing that rewards a light touch.
curated-gf-annapurna-sil-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans looks sharp and refined, with generous space at its curve ends. Annapurna SIL links its letters like a fine chain, and that tempered contrast sits comfortably above the sans on the page.
